module: Flowgraph node "Debug Sphere" (category repeat_instant, tags util/draw). Draws a debug sphere (debugDrawer:drawSphere) every frame. Inputs: pos (vec3, required), radius (hidden, 1 on the pin, 0.25 if nil), color (hidden, pink {0.91,0.05,0.48,0.5} by default).

work.desc: If pos is set, draws the sphere.
